items.briefing:
Australian small businesses are being increasingly targeted by AI-powered scams that are more convincing and personalised than ever, according to recent reporting. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has issued a warning that JetBrains TeamCity servers in Australia are being actively exploited — if your organisation uses TeamCity for software development, ensure it is patched and updated immediately.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected invoice, payment request, or urgent message — even if it looks legitimate — verify it by calling the sender directly using a number you already know, not one provided in the message.
